GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Imitative speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Imitative speaking.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Imitative speaking.

2. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Good day / hello
   B. Good night
   C. Thank you
   D. Please

3. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Wasser
   B. Haus
   C. Schule
   D. Buch

4. When practising Guided writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Guided writing.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Guided writing.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Guided writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided writing.

5. When practising Listening for gist, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for gist.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for gist.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for gist.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for gist.

6. When practising Reading Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading Comprehension.

7. When practising Reading aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading aloud.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading aloud.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading aloud.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading aloud.

8. When practising Phonological awareness , Imitative speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological awareness , Imitative speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Phonological awareness , Imitative speaking.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological awareness , Imitative speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Phonological awareness , Imitative speaking.

9. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.
